THEWILDFIRE-FIREPOWER.description: The fire raging within. Firepower can [gold]Scorch[/gold] enemies or be [gold]Exerted[/gold] to empower Wildfire cards.

THEWILDFIRE-EXERT_STATIC.title: Exert

THEWILDFIRE-FLOW_STATIC.title: Flow
THEWILDFIRE-FLOW_STATIC.description: You can achieve [color=D74040]Attack Flow[/color], [color=12AF1A]Skill Flow[/color], and [color=5D76EA]Power Flow[/color] by playing cards in the correct sequence.
